correctness.rationale: Unbiasedness follows by importance-integration identity; polynomial residual is exactly -a h^2 u(1-u), so the beta weighting cancels its randomness. The uniform C^3 interpolation expansion after division by u(1-u) is rigorous via an interpolated remainder with bounded second derivative. Beta variance 1/20 yields 1/25920; independent-cell Riemann sums and Lindeberg yield limiting variance/CLT. A curvature bound yields interval widths M h^4/6 and Hoeffding exponent 72 m^7. Cubic variance and uniform benchmark are algebraically checked. verify.py passed 194 reproducible test groups.

value.rationale: A one-point-per-cell residual correction with only endpoint linear interpolation exactly cancels quadratic noise, attains sharp m^-7 variance on C^3 integrands, and provides explicit constants, CLT, and a nonasymptotic confidence bound. It improves the comparable uniform-residual m^-5 variance and gives a constructive unique choice in a natural fixed-density design class, with only 2m+1 function values. The motivation is efficient independent randomized quadrature rather than an arbitrary polynomial trick.
